merge_dataset_with_predictions: merge a dataset JSONL file with LLM prediction JSONL file and output combined results
load_and_dump_dataset_cli: run the merge_dataset_with_pred script via fire CLI to merge dataset and prediction JSONL files
merge_by_line_field: merge predictions into dataset lines using a configurable dot-separated line field for matching
extract_pred_field: extract a configurable dot-separated prediction field from LLM response JSONL and add as pred column
report_missing_lines: report which dataset lines are missing predictions after merging dataset and prediction JSONL files
